shortBio.en: Velvet Underground vocals/guitar; deadpan street reportage. Major solo run after 1970.
shortBio.zh: Velvet Underground 人声/吉他；冷面街头纪实。1970 后有重要独唱生涯。

whyHub.en: VU → solo: same flat affect and guitar economy, from Warhol-era art-rock to Transformer/Berlin-scale authorship.
whyHub.zh: VU → 独唱：同一平面语气与吉他经济，从 Warhol 时期 art-rock 到 Transformer/Berlin 体量的作者身份。

body.en:
Born 1942, Brooklyn. Co-leads The Velvet Underground with Cale (then without): Banana album, White Light/White Heat, Loaded. Leaves 1970. Solo Transformer (1972, Bowie/Ronson) and Berlin (1973) establish a parallel catalog; later Metal Machine Music and New York keep the reportage voice.

Hub: VU tenure is the seed citation; solo decades prove the songwriter travels without the band logo.
body.zh:
1942 年生于布鲁克林。与 Cale（其后无 Cale）共领 The Velvet Underground：香蕉专、White Light/White Heat、Loaded。1970 离队。独唱 Transformer（1972，Bowie/Ronson）与 Berlin（1973）建立平行目录；后 Metal Machine Music、New York 保持纪实嗓音。

枢纽：VU 任期是种子引用；独唱数十年证明写手可离开乐队 logo 流动。

note.zh: 创始人声/吉他；90 年代有短暂重聚。

note.en: Transformer onward; parallel to VU legacy.
note.zh: 自 Transformer 起；与 VU 遗产并行。
